two_factor_reset_mail.subject: Your two-factor authentication was turned off
two_factor_reset_mail.preview: An administrator turned off two-factor on your {appName} account
two_factor_reset_mail.heading: Two-factor authentication is off
two_factor_reset_mail.intro: An administrator of {appName} turned off two-factor authentication on your account and signed you out everywhere. You now sign in with your password alone. Turn two-factor back on to protect your account.
two_factor_reset_mail.open_link: Open this link to turn it back on:
two_factor_reset_mail.warning: If you didn’t ask for this, change your password and contact support right away.
two_factor_reset_mail.footer: You received this because two-factor authentication was turned off on your account.
